reviews.text:
Rome Vet, headed by Dr.
Caniglia, is, and has been, my safe haven!!
My Chihuahua had ingested a foreign body that had blocked his small intestine... moral of the story:
urgent surgery to save him!!
Thanks to Dr. Caniglia, my Lucky is now well. After removing the stitches, I was speechless; the wound is barely visible, almost imperceptible!! Now my furry friend is fine, he's made a great recovery and is back to being the pest he always was!!
I thank all the wonderful staff who supported me, even emotionally. They were all very professional. First and foremost, I thank the person in charge of the entire staff, a true DOC, a lovely person, and it's to him that I owe the serenity I've found with my Lucky! THANK YOU!!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I've been taking my dog ​​to them for three years.
Always available and professional.

Our dog Perla was spayed laparoscopically here with them. They were incredibly attentive and caring. She was treated like a human being, not just a number. They were extremely helpful both on-site and over the phone. Perla was up and walking around on her own legs just two hours after the operation (as you can see in the photo), and the next day we left without any problems; she was running and jumping. She recovered very well and in a very short time, a truly minimally invasive procedure. Thank you so much to all the staff ❤️
And the border....

I took my Burmese to them today for the first time! The doctor was excellent and thorough, explaining every aspect of the exam in detail! All the staff were wonderful.
I'm so happy I found them! I felt listened to.

I've taken my dog ​​to this vet several times, and she's never felt comfortable, even though I know she's particularly nervous due to fear. Their approach has always been impatient and, in my opinion, overly aggressive. This is obviously due to the fact that my dog ​​is wary of vets, but they didn't do anything to reassure her and simply forced their procedures (the checkups).

Today, my dog ​​saw Dr. Caniglia for the first time for the leishmaniasis vaccine, despite numerous visits. The doctor's approach was brusque from the start; since it was her first time, he didn't even introduce himself to the dog, letting her sniff him, which I think is at least normal, but obviously I trusted him since I know him well.
He proceeded with the stethoscope and then prepared for the vaccine. When it was time for the vaccination, my dog ​​became agitated, and the doctor began to calm her down using force. Then, seeing the dog trying to free himself, he used even more force, using a typical dog chokehold to hold puppies. However, the doctor's grip seemed more aggressive, almost strangling the animal. I understand the doctor's attempt to protect himself from a possible bite, but then, having let go of the animal, in a fit of rage, the doctor kicked my dog. Not hard enough to hurt her, but the action still seemed rather unprofessional.

I thought it was my dog's fault, so I looked for another vet to see if that was actually the case.

That same day, I took her to another vet, two hours after Dr. Caniglia's visit, and my dog ​​acted more trusting towards the new doctor, so much so that she had every type of physical check done, including chest and ear examinations and a thermometer (which she had never had before), and finally the vaccination that she was previously supposed to have with Dr. Caniglia.
With the new doctor, she even wags her tail, something that has never happened before.

This made me realize that it's not the animal that's wrong, but this office's approach to furry friends, which they don't like.

There are no reviews, but I've heard from other people who've had a similar experience, including the new doctor's cat, who had a similar episode with Dr. Caniglia.

(Here's my dog's calm in the new office, the same kick from the doctor.)

I've been bringing my two cats here for a few years, even though we live on the other side of Rome. Dr. Caniglia is always available and thorough, never doing anything that isn't necessary, never a superficial examination, and so patient even with my myriad questions (yes, I'm a little anxious about the two old cats). We've had two surgeries, and both times, Rodolfo and Valentino came home perfect. 5 stars, but I'd give more if I could!
Excellent clinic run by a person with a heart and a great knowledge. Highly recommended!

They are the best in Rome without a doubt I have a French bulldog who is 6 years old until 2 years ago I went every month with him to the vet because they could not understand what he has in his ears until I found them time and money spent without any result since I found them my little heart is very well I really recommend them 🔝🔝🔝 …

Unprofessional, often incompetent, and often don't issue receipts.
Very expensive compared to other veterinary clinics.
Know-it-all and unclear doctors; if it were up to them, my dog ​​would have died.
They sign the name of the person in charge, Dr. Caniglia, on reports and visits that he DID NOT PERFORM.
ABSOLUTELY NOT RECOMMENDED.

I spayed my dog ​​on October 28th, and I was so scared. When we entered, Dr. Caniglia welcomed us, cuddling Lilith, and it was reassuring. The doctor who administered the anesthesia also cuddled and kissed my frightened little girl. While she was relaxing under the pre-anesthesia, they created a comfortable environment for us. All these little touches made me feel more at ease. I thank the doctors and staff for their kindness and helpfulness in explaining things. My dog ​​had a spay and a preventative laparoscopic gastropexy. She's doing great, and we'll soon resume our walks in the woods. Thank you for everything.

Many years have passed since Dr. Caniglia became my trusted veterinarian—competent, empathetic, and professional.
My two dachshunds, Bobo and Spillo, only let him touch them!
Empathetic, helpful and above all good!!!

Highly recommended! Dr. Renato was exceptional in his care of my Balù. His professionalism and kindness always made me and my four-legged friend feel at ease.
In particular, the acupuncture therapy has yielded amazing results! My Balù is showing a marked improvement in his condition and seems much happier and more relaxed. He's regained his will to live 🫶🏻👍🏻⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
They don't take proper care of the animals, it's a shame :(

I want to express my sincere and profound thanks to Dr. Caniglia for his extraordinary expertise, humanity, and dedication. He performed a very delicate and complex operation on my 14-year-old dog, Jenny, during which a mammary gland, uterus, and ovaries were removed.

From the very first moment, Dr. Caniglia welcomed us with professionalism and sensitivity, explaining everything clearly and reassuring us during a difficult time. The surgery went perfectly, and Jenny is making an excellent recovery, receiving careful post-operative care.

A special thank you also goes to his wonderful staff: knowledgeable, kind, and always available. They treated Jenny with care and LOVE, making us feel supported and never alone throughout the entire process.

It is rare to meet professionals who combine great technical preparation with a genuine passion for their work and for animals.
Dr. Caniglia and his team are truly exemplary.

Thank you so much, from all of us and our little Jenny! ❤️🌈

I would like to extend my immense thanks to Dr. Renato Caniglia for calling me on the emergency phone on Sunday, March 16th, for my sweet cat Sissi, for his professionalism and valuable advice, and to my beloved Dr. Giusy Recupero, who always supported me with expertise
in the days that followed.
They are simply wonderful.
I'm Giulietto, a beautiful cat!!! And Renato is my doctor!!! He's a really nice guy, besides being very good!!! 😺😻 …
Fantastic thanks
Excellent service, professional doctor

I've been a Romavet client for over 25 years.
I have to thank the expertise of Dr. Caniglia and the entire team of doctors and staff for the excellent health of my dogs and cats, both today and in the past.
Thank you to all the Romavet staff.
Congratulations to everyone! Well done and professional!
Thanks Marco if you want to give us advice on the small disappointment it will help us grow

I had my dachshund Matilda spayed by Dr. Caniglia, who recommended laparoscopic surgery. I was amazed to see my dog ​​leave the office, walk calmly, and walk back to the car without any problems. She ate and slept peacefully, and in the morning she chased her favorite ball! Oh, and she has virtually no marks on her belly except for two tiny holes.
I am completely satisfied with the office and my favorite vet. Thank you!

Terrible experience, I brought my 1.5 kg Chihuahua at 6:30 pm waiting in the waiting room without anyone welcoming us. A customer opened the door for me after an hour of waiting the girl comes out closing what had happened And I explained to her that my Chihuahua was limping And she replied I can't examine him it's too late and I'm alone Try going somewhere else that does emergency because we're closing here I asked her if she could kindly just prescribe me a painkiller And she replied I can't give it to you Because I don't know what it is come back tomorrow for an X-ray. I'm speechless this is not professionalism And stealing money and not loving animals. Two incompetent and unpleasant girls.
Thank you thank you 🙂 …
Thank you Roberta. Best regards.
I've been there a while ago and I have to say I wasn't disappointed. The clinic was clean and the vets were competent and friendly! The only downside was that parking was almost impossible to find.
Hi, I'm Lusy, a black cat with severe ear infection and weight loss. Dr. Francesca is treating me with professionalism and patience, and I highly recommend her to all my friends!
